notes.title: Copperbell Award Nomination Update & Discount
notes.notes:
[h1]Copperbell is a hidden gem![/h1]
We're happy to announce that Copperbell is one of the four nominees for the "Hidden Gem" award in the 2019 Central & Eastern European Game Awards!

In honour of our nomination, we're offering a 25% discount from October 15th until October 28th! To sweeten the deal, we've also prepared an update with graphical polish and balance improvements!

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
Here's a detailed list of what's new and improved in this update:
[list]
[*] [b]Graphics update:[/b] We improved our visuals across the board, with better environments, additional animations and effects, and updated sprites and UI!
[*] [b]Balance changes:[/b] We tweaked the difficulties of some of the boss fights according to player feedback.
[*] [b]Unity analytics:[/b] This helps us better understand if you are getting stuck on some levels and what parts of the game you  explore. Of course, you can opt out in Copperbell's options menu!
[/list]

If you want to find out more about the CEEGA awards, go to their [url=https://ceega.eu/]official website[/url].
